nary_nodes.label: Hurricane Lala impacts Big Island
evidence: One person was killed in a storm-related car crash as Hurricane Lala brought fierce winds and pouring rain to Hawaii’s Big Island on Saturday.
Footage on social media showed floodwaters rising, overtaking roadways and bridges as Lala dumped rain on Hawaii’s Big Island.
According to the National Weather Service’s Honolulu office, two homes were swept away due to intense rainfall over Naalehu, with flash flooding ongoing.
Maximum sustained winds near 75 mph with higher gusts were recorded as the storm advanced.
Forecasters said higher elevations on the island, dominated by the towering Mauna Kea volcano, could get as much as 25 inches of rain.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing the effects of a hurricane on a region or population.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Hurricane impacts are not explicitly covered by schema.org's existing Event classes.

nary_nodes.label: Power outages on Big Island
evidence: More than 125,000 utility customers in the state, mostly on the Big Island, were without electricity, according to utility tracker PowerOutage.us.
Electricity was knocked out for 10% of customers on the Big Island, according to poweroutage.us.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing damage to physical infrastructure caused by an incident.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Infrastructure damage events are not explicitly covered by schema.org's existing classes.

nary_nodes.label: Search and rescue in Alihu and Waiheno
evidence: Hawaii County Mayor Kimo Alameda said in an Instagram post that 'several occupied homes may have been swept off their foundations' amid flash flooding in the Alihu and Waiheno areas, with a search and rescue mission underway.
Honolulu Mayor Rick Blangiardi said at a news conference that search and rescue crews were working in dire conditions at Oahu’s Lulumahu Falls Trail to find a hiker.
Honolulu Ocean Safety Department Director Kurt Lager said lifeguards made 59 rescues Saturday.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An organized event involving the search and rescue of individuals in distress or hazardous conditions.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Rescue operations are not explicitly covered by schema.org's existing Event classes.

nary_nodes.label: Governor Green warns of worsening conditions
evidence: Gov. Josh Green said on X. 'Conditions are worsening across Maui County, Oʻahu and Kaua‘i tonight.'
Green described it as an 'enormous storm' and warned of destructive flooding and even the possibility of wildfires kicked up by strong winds across the island chain.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Blangiardi urges caution
evidence: Honolulu Mayor Rick Blangiardi said at a news conference that search and rescue crews were working in dire conditions at Oahu’s Lulumahu Falls Trail to find a hiker.
He urged people not to get in the water on Sunday.

nary_nodes.label: Director Lager issues safety warnings
evidence: Honolulu Ocean Safety Department Director Kurt Lager said lifeguards made 59 rescues Saturday. He urged people not to get in the water on Sunday.
'It’s not a day to come to the beach,' he said at the news conference. 'It’s not a day to go paddling or surfing.'

evidence: A Category 3 hurricane hit the northeast corner of the Big Island in 1871, according to research by a University of Hawaii atmospheric scientist.
